'''2000 Tennessee State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Nashville, TN on 8 April 2000. It is known from Jonny Chu's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d499">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-nashville-tn-4-8-2000d499/ nashville-tn-4-8-2000], DeckTech (Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu, 10 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-nashville-tn-4-8-2000d499/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Nashville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Hayes Hunter's GenCon 2000 report calls his opponent Matt Baker the 'guy who won TN states'; Steven Lewis's GenCon report says the Tennessee states Continental Day 2 spots went to Steven Turner and Matt Crigger, and the hub lists Matt Crigger 2nd with no winner.<ref name="tr-d1126">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-hayes-hunter-goes-to-gencond1126/ hayes-hunter-goes-to-gencon], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 14 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-hayes-hunter-goes-to-gencond1126/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
